title: TypeScript-Native AI Agent and Durable Workflow Framework
oneLiner: Mastra provides a TypeScript framework for building agents with typed tools, RAG pipelines, suspend-and-resume workflows, and built-in evals designed for modern Next.js and Node.js stacks.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Mastra provides a TypeScript framework for building agents with typed tools, RAG pipelines, suspend-and-resume workflows, and built-in evals designed for modern Next.js and Node.js stacks.
steps: Define agents, tools, and workflow steps in TypeScript
Test in local Mastra Playground UI
Deploy to serverless or Node server.
configSnippet: "Create a workflow that drafts a newsletter, suspends for human approval via webhook, and publishes upon confirmation."
limitations: Focused exclusively on the TypeScript/JavaScript ecosystem rather than Python.
